BankAccount.title: Bank Account
BankAccount.description: Represents a bank account for the system, used for payments and transfers.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Bank Account entity.

bankName.description: The name of the bank (e.g., 'بنك الكريمي').

accountName.description: The name of the account holder (e.g., 'شركة أبشر للتوصيل').

logoUrl.description: URL to an image of the bank's logo.

isActive.description: Whether the bank account is active and can be used for transactions.

Governorate.title: Governorate
Governorate.description: Represents a Yemeni administrative division, which users can select as their current location.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Governorate entity.

name.description: The Arabic name of the governorate (e.g., 'صنعاء').

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores non-authentication related profile information for a user, including selected governorate and favorite stores.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity. This typically corresponds to an external authentication system's user ID.

phoneNumber.description: The user's phone number, used for identification and communication. (Not used for authentication itself, which is external).

governorateId.description: Reference to the selected Governorate. (Relationship: Governorate 1:N UserProfile)

favoriteStoreIds.description: References to Stores the user has marked as favorites. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N Store)

StoreCategory.title: StoreCategory
StoreCategory.description: Defines categories for stores, allowing users to filter and discover different types of businesses.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StoreCategory entity.

name.description: The Arabic name of the category (e.g., 'مطاعم', 'صيدليات').

iconUrl.description: URL to an image representing the category icon.

AdBanner.title: Ad Banner
AdBanner.description: Represents a promotional banner with a configurable action.

name.description: An internal name for the ad banner for easy identification.

imageUrl.description: URL to the image displayed in the banner.

displayOrder.description: Order for displaying banners, lower values first.

isActive.description: Whether the ad is currently active and visible.

expiryDate.description: Optional date when the ad should automatically become inactive.

actionType.description: The type of action to perform when clicked.

targetIds.description: The IDs of the target entities (Store, Product, or DonationCampaign) if actionType is not 'none'.

Store.title: Store
Store.description: Details about a specific store or business available for delivery in the app.

imageUrl.description: URL to the main image representing the store.

rating.description: The average rating of the store, typically on a scale (e.g., 0.0 to 5.0).

deliveryTime.description: Estimated delivery time in minutes, e.g., '25-35'.

provinceId.description: Reference to the AppProvince this store is in.

categoryId.description: Reference to the AppCategory this store belongs to.

latitude.description: The geographical latitude of the store's location.

longitude.description: The geographical longitude of the store's location.

is_active.description: Whether the store is currently active and visible to users.

workingHours.description: An array defining the working hours for each day of the week.

AppProvince.title: App Province
AppProvince.description: Represents a governorate with its administrative and contact details for the app.

province_name.description: The Arabic name of the governorate.

customer_service_number.description: The customer service phone number for the governorate.

whatsapp_number.description: WhatsApp contact number (9 digits Yemeni number).

is_active.description: Whether the governorate is active in the system.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the record was last updated.

AppCategory.title: App Category
AppCategory.description: Represents a global category for stores in the app.

StoreFilter.title: Store Filter
StoreFilter.description: Represents a sub-category or filter within a specific store.

parent_store_id.description: The ID of the store this filter belongs to.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents an item sold by a store.

description.description: A detailed description of the product.

storeId.description: Reference to the Store this product belongs to.

categoryId.description: Reference to the AppCategory this product falls under.

filterId.description: Reference to a specific StoreFilter within the parent store.

rating.description: The initial or average rating of the product.

mainImageUrl.description: URL for the main product image.

hasVariants.description: Whether the product has multiple types/sizes.

basePrice.description: The price of the product if it has no variants.

variants.description: List of product variants (e.g., sizes, colors).

is_active.description: Whether the product is active and available for sale.

DonationType.title: Donation Type
DonationType.description: Defines a type of donation that can be made, e.g., 'Water Provision', 'Build a Mosque'.

name.description: The name of the donation type (e.g., 'سقيا ماء').

imageUrl.description: URL for an expressive image for the donation type.

isActive.description: Whether this donation type is currently visible/active.

Donation.title: Donation
Donation.description: Represents a single donation entry recorded in the system.

donorName.description: The name of the person who made the donation.

donorPhone.description: The phone number of the donor (optional).

typeId.description: Reference to the DonationType this donation falls under.

campaignId.description: Optional reference to a specific DonationCampaign.

paymentMethod.description: The method used for the donation.

bankAccountId.description: Reference to the BankAccount if payment was via bank transfer.

receiptNumber.description: The receipt or reference number for the bank transfer.

receiptImageUrl.description: URL for the image of the transfer receipt.

donationDate.description: The date the donation was made or recorded.

DonationCampaign.title: Donation Campaign
DonationCampaign.description: Represents a promotional campaign for a specific donation cause.

title.description: The title of the donation campaign.

description.description: A detailed description of the campaign's purpose and goals.

goalAmount.description: The financial target for the campaign.

imageUrl.description: URL for the campaign's promotional image.

isActive.description: Whether the campaign is currently active and visible.

minOrderAmount.description: Minimum order amount for the coupon to be valid.

maxDiscount.description: Maximum discount amount for percentage-based coupons.

expiryDate.description: The expiration date of the coupon.

maxUses.description: Total number of times the coupon can be used.

currentUses.description: How many times the coupon has been used.

storeIds.description: List of store IDs if scope is 'stores'.

productIds.description: List of product IDs if scope is 'products'.

definition.description: Stores bank account details for the system. This data is sensitive and should only be managed by administrators.

Stores details of Yemeni governorates. This is a global, publicly readable collection, primarily for users to select their location. No denormalized authorization fields are required, as access is public.

Stores user-specific profile information such as phone number, selected governorate, and favorite stores. This is a private, user-owned document where the document ID ('profile') and the parent `{userId}` match the authenticated user's ID (`request.auth.uid`), ensuring Authorization Independence. The 'id' field within the document also matches `{userId}`.
Defines categories for stores, used for filtering and discovery. This is a global, publicly readable collection. No denormalized authorization fields are required, as access is public.
Contains promotional banner information for the home screen. This data is managed by administrators, but is publicly readable.
Details about individual stores or businesses. This collection is publicly readable, but write access is restricted to administrators for managing store information.
Stores administrative details for each governorate. This data is managed by administrators.
Stores global app categories for stores. This data is managed by administrators.
Stores filters/sub-categories for specific stores. This data is managed by administrators.
Stores all products available in the app across all stores. Publicly readable, but write access is restricted to administrators.
Stores individual donation records. Restricted to admin access.
Stores the different types of donations available. Admin-managed but publicly readable.
Stores donation campaign information. Admin-managed, publicly readable.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed following the core principles of Authorization Independence, Structural Segregation, and Access Modeling to ensure security, scalability, and debuggability. All entities are placed in top-level collections or user-specific subcollections to simplify security rules and avoid complex hierarchical dependencies.

**Authorization Independence:**
*   For global, publicly accessible data such as `Governorate`, `StoreCategory`, `AdBanner`, `Store`, `Product`, `DonationType`, and `DonationCampaign`, documents are stored in top-level collections. Their authorization rules will be simple, typically `allow read: if true;` for public access, and `allow write: if request.auth.uid in get(/roles_admin/$(request.auth.uid));` for administrative actions. This completely avoids the need for `get()` calls within rules for authorization checks on these documents themselves.
*   For private user-owned data like `UserProfile`, the document is placed in a user-specific path: `/users/{userId}/profile`. The `id` field within the `UserProfile` document will explicitly match the `{userId}` wildcard in the path, ensuring that `request.auth.uid == userId` is the sole and sufficient authorization check. This also removes any need for `get()` calls to other documents for `UserProfile` authorization, thereby enabling atomic operations.
*   For sensitive admin-only data like `BankAccount`, `AppProvince`, `AppCategory`, `StoreFilter`, `Donation`, and `Coupon`, documents are stored in top-level collections. Access will be strictly controlled via security rules, likely based on a custom claim or a separate `admins` collection, ensuring only authorized administrators can read or write this data.

**Querying and Authorization Postures (QAPs - Rules are not Filters):**
*   `Governorates`, `StoreCategories`, `AdBanners`, `Stores`, `Products`, `DonationTypes`, and `DonationCampaigns` are designed as globally readable collections. This means `list` operations on these collections can be broadly allowed (e.g., `allow list: if true;` or `allow list: if request.auth != null;`). The application's UI filtering requirements will be handled client-side using appropriate queries and filtering logic, rather than relying on Firestore security rules to filter results. This adheres to the QAP principle, preventing rules from acting as data filters, which would be inefficient and difficult to debug.
*   For `UserProfile`, `list` operations are not applicable given its single-document-per-user structure within a subcollection. Access is restricted to `get` operations for the authenticated user, which does not violate QAP.
*   For `BankAccount`, `AppProvince`, `AppCategory`, `StoreFilter`, `Donation`, and `Coupon`, `list` operations will be restricted to admin users, which is a valid QAP as the rule itself doesn't filter based on the *content* of the documents, but rather on the *identity* of the user making the request.

This design prioritizes explicit ownership, minimal rule complexity, and efficient data retrieval, aligning with the mandated design principles.
